cohort: Women admitted for delivery at Oslo University Hospital and Drammen Hospital between January 1, 2008 and December 31, 2011
finding: Assisted reproductive technology was associated with an increased risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage after adjusting for confounding and interaction.
mod_finding: Assisted reproductive technology was associated with an increased risk of severe postpartum hemorrhage, even after adjusting for mode of delivery and multiple pregnancies.
